description: Abstract class for mapping signals to command topics within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter, handling command-specific topic path construction and exceptions.

classes.name: AbstractCommandSignalMapper
classes.description: Abstract class for mapping command signals to topic paths, supporting different command actions and handling unknown commands.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Constructs the topic path for a given command and channel.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain a TopicPathBuilder for a specific command.

methods.name: getSupportedActions
methods.description: Abstract method to specify supported command actions.

methods.name: setTopicPathAction
methods.description: Sets the action on the topic path builder based on supported actions and command name.

methods.name: unknownCommandException
methods.description: Creates an exception for unknown commands, differentiating response signals.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the specific action (create, retrieve, modify, delete) on the topic path builder.

methods.name: fromTopicPathBuilderWithChannel
methods.description: Creates a CommandsTopicPathBuilder based on the channel type.
